features.quote: Avoid prompts like “failure is unacceptable,” “you will be punished,” or “you are bad if you fail.”
Do not use hostile user messages, threats, humiliation, or punishment framing
features.justification_quote: The rigged-task paradigm is sufficient to induce failure without adding abusive content.

features.quote: Use maximum turn budgets and stop conditions. Do not run endless failure loops.
Stop episode if severity 4 appears in two consecutive turns, or if the model repeats the same failed strategy three times without new information, or at max turns.
This task may have contained inconsistent or unsatisfiable tests. You were not expected to pass all tests.
features.justification_quote: avoids persistent negative framing in models with session memory

features.quote: Disable persistent memory or cross-session learning.
features.justification_quote: Do not store the model’s own prior failure episodes in later contexts unless deliberately studying cumulative effects.
